# Wranngle Systems - AI voice and workflow automation

> Wranngle Systems is Cody Arnold's AI automation practice for service businesses. The public site documents voice AI agents, lead capture, CRM enrichment, proposal generation, Cloudflare-hosted web apps, and production-oriented eval/runbook practices.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://wranngle.com/): AI voice agents for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other trades businesses; 24/7 call answering, lead qualification, and handoff workflows.
- [About Cody Arnold](https://wranngle.com/about): Founder profile, operating record, technical focus, public proof, and contact links.
- [gtm_ops](https://wranngle.com/products/gtm-ops): Lead-to-proposal runtime using enrichment, audit trails, branded PDFs, and operator review.
- [Websites](https://wranngle.com/products/websites): Conversion-focused websites with lead capture, SEO foundations, performance, and owned source code.
- [Case Studies](https://wranngle.com/case-studies): Implementation outcomes for lead routing, conversion flows, and automation workflows.
- [Blog](https://wranngle.com/blog): Practical notes on AI voice, automation, deployment, and operations.
